messages:
Ivy (partnerships): HexaChip asked to co-run a performance-per-watt + kernel-tuning article for their HC-2 board. They want a concise public table + a reproducible methods appendix. Can we scope something compact that still shows kernel-level wins? @Marco @Pri @Sam please chime in. Diego: what can you provide on telemetry and firmware?
Marco (eng-runtime): Keep it focused: 3 models (7b, 13b, 70b), 2 quant modes (int8,int4), and 3 batch points (1,8,16). Kernels to compare: stock, hc2-optimized, and flash-attn-v3. Run both a short burst (60s steady) and a sustained 15-minute sample to show thermal drift. We'll capture tokens/s, p95 latency, avg power (W), and energy/token.
Pri (eng-ml): For quality, we'll use our standard prompt pack and deterministic seeds. Public note should include delta-perplexity and a brief note on int4 calibration. Gate: if int4 degrades >3% relative to int8, flag it.
Sam (eng-infra): Telemetry: need wall-power at 1s, per-board chip power at 500ms if possible, ambient/rack temp. Tag every row with run_id, kernel_variant, firmware_rev. Ingestion target: s3://redwood-benching/hexachip/hc2/{run_id}/telemetry.jsonl. Also set an alert to abort runs if power variance > 12% across repeats.
Diego (HexaChip): We can provide 4 HC-2 boards in Palo Alto lab, firmware 2.1. PDUs and a metrics agent are available. We'll expose hc-prof and a /metrics endpoint; ACL access for Redwood infra ok. Firmware 2.2 is a candidate with extra perf counters but not for press.
Ivy (partnerships): Proposed timeline: week1 dry-run (7b small matrix), week2 full sweep, week3 validation + docs + legal review. Tentative embargo: late-August. Who owns the writeup?
Marco (eng-runtime): I'll own the runbook and kernel toggle matrix. Need the ABI doc and hc-prof binary from HexaChip. Example run command I'll include in the runbook: 
```bash
./run_bench \
  --model llamaX-70b \
  --quant int8 \
  --kernel hc2-optimized \
  --batch 8 \
  --duration 900 \
  --out s3://redwood-benching/hexachip/hc2/{run_ts}/llamaX-70b-int8-b8/ \
  --tags run_id=hc2-1969001111,kernel=hc2-optimized,firmware=2.1
```
Marco (eng-runtime): We'll snapshot perf counters pre/post with `hc-prof --snap run_id`. Also require NTP sync on host and board.
Pri (eng-ml): I'll prepare the eval set and a small script to compute delta metrics; will place them in bench/evals/hexachip. Quality gate: perplexity increase >2.5% => mark.
Sam (eng-infra): I'll create the ingestion bucket, dashboard, and alerting. Alert rules: missing telemetry > 7% -> fail run; power variance > 12% -> flag for triage. I'll also record ambient temp/inlet if available.
Diego (HexaChip): Uploading hc-prof and ABI docs to secure link now. PDUs and boards available next Wed (1969080000). We'll provide ACL and a short README for counters.
benchbot: bench-run queued: id=hc2-1969001111, owner=marco, matrix=3models x {int8,int4} x 3batch-sizes, sustained=15m on select samples.
Ruth (marketing): For the public piece, we want one canonical quoted run and a methods appendix that includes kernel flags and telemetry methods. We'll avoid any customer-specific data. Diego: can HexaChip sign an embargo?
Diego (HexaChip): Yes, embargo OK for late-August. We'll provide a short hardware note about clock/gpu-power caps and cooling.
Ivy (partnerships): Action items: Marco runbook + kernel matrix, Pri evals + seeds, Sam telemetry + ingestion + alerts, Diego deliver hc-prof/ABI + ACL, Ruth draft announcement + coordinate legal. Quick Q: are we comfortable publishing int4 numbers? Marco/Pri?
Marco (eng-runtime): Int4 is fine as long as we show accuracy deltas and list calibration steps. We'll include a footnote on our quant toolchain (post-train per-channel scales).
Pri (eng-ml): Agree. Add a short appendix: "int4 may require calibration; see methods."
Sam (eng-infra): Also capture lab ambient temp and note it in the appendix -- helps explain run variance.
Ivy (partnerships): Great. Next sync after dry-run artifacts. :calendar:
Marco (eng-runtime): I'll upload the draft runbook by EOD tomorrow.
Pri (eng-ml): Eval pack posted to repo later today.
Diego (HexaChip): ACL + binaries posted. ETA lab Wed.
Sam (eng-infra): Ingestion and dashboards being provisioned.
Ivy (partnerships): Thanks all :thumbsup:  closing thread, post any updates here.
